name: Raffles London at The OWO
positioning: Raffles' first London hotel, in the restored Old War Office building in the heart of Whitehall
best_for: History lovers drawn to the building's wartime and spy past
Food lovers interested in Mauro Colagreco's menu of British-grown produce
Travelers who want a spa with a swimming pool in central London

facts.text: The hotel is located in the heart of Whitehall.
Raffles London is in the former Old War Office building, known today as The OWO.
The building was once home to Sir Winston Churchill and Lord Haldane.
The Edwardian Baroque building was restored by expert craftspeople and transformed into Raffles' first London hotel.
The room design was masterminded by Thierry Despont, who previously worked on the Statue of Liberty.
Heritage Suite stays include personalised butler service, flexible check-in and check-out, and complimentary airport transfers.
The Lifestyle Suite includes wellbeing tools such as yoga equipment, TRX suspension and Normatec recovery boots.
The Mauro Colagreco menu features more than 70 varieties of vegetable and fruit, all produced in Britain.
Afternoon tea is served in The Drawing Room, with a choice of two experiences.
The spa combines Guerlain treatments with movement and nutrition expertise from Pillar Wellbeing.
The spa has a swimming pool, a vitality pool, a sauna and a steam room.

highlights.text: MI5 and MI6 had operations in the building during the 20th century.
Ian Fleming, creator of James Bond, was a regular visitor to the building, and scenes from the 007 movies were filmed there.
During the Second World War, candidate spies for the Special Operations Executive were interviewed and briefed in the building's basement.
The Turret Suite is a two-level suite at the top of a turret, with the bedroom below and the living room above.
Chef Mauro Colagreco has his signature restaurant at the hotel, one of three dining experiences he oversees there.

considerations.text: Children over the age of 12 are welcome at Mauro Colagreco and are offered the regular menu.
Mauro Colagreco reservations must be cancelled at least 48 hours in advance to avoid a charge.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the hotel's exclusive positioning.
